description: Helm release shop/web: chart web 2.0.0 requires Kubernetes ">=1.19.0-0 <1.25.0-0" (target 1.25). Chart web 2.0.0 (revision 12 of Helm release shop/web) declares kubeVersion ">=1.19.0-0 <1.25.0-0" in Chart.yaml, which Kubernetes 1.25 does not satisfy. Helm refuses to install or upgrade a chart whose kubeVersion excludes the cluster version, so once the cluster runs 1.25 every helm upgrade of this release fails until it moves to a chart version that supports 1.25. Fix: upgrade the release to a chart version whose kubeVersion includes 1.25 before upgrading the cluster.
batch/v1beta1 CronJob removed in 1.25 (1 object). 1 object(s) written through this API version: batch (1). Written by: helm. Objects: batch/nightly. Fix: migrate to batch/v1 CronJob.

helm upgrade of release batch/jobs will fail: its manifest uses batch/v1beta1 CronJob. Revision 7 of Helm release batch/jobs (chart jobs 1.4.0) stores a manifest with 1 object at APIs Kubernetes 1.25 does not serve: batch/v1beta1 CronJob (removed in 1.25; 1 object). Helm refuses to upgrade a release whose stored manifest uses APIs the cluster no longer serves. Objects: weekly (line 31). Fix: upgrade the release to a chart version that renders supported APIs (batch/v1 CronJob) before upgrading the cluster; if the cluster already stopped serving them, rewrite the stored manifest with the helm-mapkubeapis plugin first.

Helm release ops/status-page manifest uses deprecated v1 ComponentStatus. Revision 3 of Helm release ops/status-page (chart status-page 0.9.1) stores a manifest with 1 object at deprecated APIs: v1 ComponentStatus (deprecated in 1.19; 1 object). Objects: etcd-0 (line 12). Fix: upgrade the release to a chart version that renders supported APIs.

Helm release shop/legacy-web: chart kubeVersion ">=1.21.0-0 <<1.30" could not be parsed. Chart legacy-web 0.1.0 (revision 2 of Helm release shop/legacy-web) declares kubeVersion ">=1.21.0-0 <<1.30" in Chart.yaml, which is not a valid semver constraint, so the chart's Kubernetes compatibility was not assessed.
